plan: Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet mandate limits.

conservative.read: This conservative plan targets approximately 1.5% monthly, prioritizing capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and high-beta names. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also more modest growth potential.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to meet concentration limits.
Trim QQQI to 20% to slightly reduce income focus.
Add to CRWD, bringing it to 15%, as it is a strong uptrending name.
Reduce leveraged ETFs SOXL to 2% and SPAL to 1%, and MSFU to 1%.

balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for approximately 2.5% monthly, focusing on risk-first growth. It blends broad index exposure with quality tech and reduced leverage. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns, with a balanced growth outlook.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to meet concentration limits.
Trim QQQI to 10% to shift focus from income to growth.
Add to CRWD, bringing it to 15%, leveraging its strong uptrend.
Increase exposure to leveraged ETFs SOXL to 5% and SPAL to 3%.
Buy new positions in TECS, SQQQ, and TZA at 5% each, based on strong scanner setups.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets approximately 4% monthly, aiming for stretched growth. It utilizes leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware of significantly higher volatility, potential for larger drawdowns, and the daily decay/rebalancing of leveraged ETFs. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet mandate limits.

income.read: This income plan targets approximately 1% monthly, focusing on parking cash for yield.
